stories.title: Nicole Kidman lip-syncs 'Nicole Kidman' at Chanel with Dua and Pedro
stories.summary: Before Chanel's Spring/Summer 2027 show in Paris, Kristen Wiig, Pedro Pascal and Dua Lipa passed a phone down the front row lip-syncing ADELA's viral song 'Nicole Kidman', ending on Kidman herself mouthing her own name and blowing a kiss. Chanel posted the clip to TikTok, where it drew about 1.6 million likes and close to 95,000 shares. It became the definitive entry in a trend built on the song, and fans loved that the song's namesake joined in.
